verses.verse:
मन्द्र पंचम धैवतयो र्मध्ये कोमल धैवतः।
षड्ज धैवतयो र्मध्ये निषादौ द्वौ समानकौ।।२५।।
verses.text: Between lower Pañcama and Dhaivata is komal Dhaivata; between Ṣaḍja and Dhaivata are the two Niṣādas, equally spaced.

commentary.text: That is, komal Dhaivata will be between the lower Pañcama and śuddha Dhaivata, and both Niṣādas will lie at equal distances between śuddha Dhaivata and Ṣaḍja. Here some may doubt: when, by the earlier rule, the gaps between the holes also contract as the pipe gets shorter, how is it that equal distances have been written for Dha, Ni, Ni and Sa? This will be resolved by the following śloka.
